references.text: Genesis 3:15 refers to the conflict between the woman's offspring and the serpent, which is an early reference to the struggle between good and evil, represented by Jesus and the devil in Matthew 13:39.
Daniel 12:3 speaks of the end times and the reward of the righteous, corresponding with the idea of harvesting at the end of time in Matthew 13:39.
Revelation 14:15-20 describes the harvest of the earth, which is a direct parallel to the harvest mentioned in Matthew 13:39.
